detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A loot-based idle game where dice roll across your screen, triggering skills on monsters, farming them for you.

Let it run full-screen, or dock it in the corner of your desktop, or strip everything down into a gadget for loot to know when an extremely rare loot drops.

Main features of the game:

  • Itemized Dice: Every dice is a piece of loot with unique stats and skills.

  • Endless Loot Hunting: Monsters drop dice, gemstones, scrolls, combo rings, relics, and automator gears each pushing your build further and unlocking new synergies.

  • Prestige & Skill Trees: Rebirth to unlock 4 skill trees that significantly transform your game and provide powerful bonuses.

  • Maps: Enter a new world with powerful rewards.

  • And many more systems.
